8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.

Appointment to the Commission for the Arts to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 1, 2023 . Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The City Council approve the Mayor’s recommendation to appoint James Hebert to fill one unscheduled vacancy on the Commission for the Arts with a term ending March 1, 2023.

Adoption of Ordinance No. 2022-02 for amendments to Chapters 23.08 (Design Review) and 30.16 (Residential Zones) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, the Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, Encinitas Ranch, and Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plans, and the Local Coastal Program to provide for objective design standards for multiple family and mixed-use housing development. Contact Person: Planning Manager Gates

2022-02-09 Item 08D Objective Design Standards Ordinance Adoption
8E.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2022-03 to adopt modifications approved by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2020-10 (with the exception of the provisions regarding replacement parking), which amended the Zoning Code and Local Coastal Program (LCP) to modify the regulations and requirements for accessory dwelling units (ADUs) and junior accessory dwelling units (JADUs) consistent with recent changes in state law. Contact Person: Associate Planner Jedynak
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2022-03 titled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting the Modifications Suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2020-10, Amending Section 30.48.040 (Accessory Use Regulations) and Section 30.76.120 (Remodeling or Reconstruction of Residential Buildings with Structural/Use Nonconformity) of Title 30, (Zoning) with the Exception of the Provisions Regarding Replacement Parking."
2022-02-09 Item 08E ADU CCC Modifications Ordinance Adoption

Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance 2022-01, adding Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.30- Balloon Ordinance. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock

Ratify grant application to San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) Housing Acceleration Grant Program (HAP) for an amount of $310,000. Contact Person: Planner IV Dacey
Adopt Resolution No. 2022-17 titled "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council, ratifying and authorizing the filing of an application for grant funds from the San Diego Association of Governments and accepting the terms of the grant agreement" and authorize the City Manager to enter into, execute and deliver an agreement with SANDAG for an amount to be awarded.

Contract Amendment for Dredging and Grading of the Cottonwood Creek Detention Basin. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
1) Ratify Amendment No. 1 to the Contract for Dredging and Grading of the Cottonwood Creek Basin Between the City of Encinitas and Entenman Development Group ; and 2) Ratify a Budget Transfer from Citywide Flood and Channel Maintenance (Project WC09D) to Cottonwood Creek Basin Maintenance (Project CD20A) in the amount of $43,860; and 3) Adopt Resolution 2022-20 Amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 Budget.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
